tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Achebe
professor.text: For the past few classes, we have been discussing the concept of social mobility which refers to the ability of individuals or families to move up or down the social hierarchy. Some argue that education is the key to social mobility, while others believe that networking and personal connections are more important. Which viewpoint do you agree with? Why?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I believe that education is the key to social mobility. With a good education, individuals can acquire the knowledge and skills needed to access better job opportunities and improve their social status. We have always been taught that education provides a foundation for long-term success and upward mobility.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: In my opinion, networking and personal connections are more crucial for social mobility. Knowing the right people can open doors to opportunities that education alone might not provide. Therefore, personal connections can lead to job offers, mentorship, and other advantages that help individuals climb the social ladder.
